remarks: Experience the best of New Canaan living in this impeccable first-floor corner-unit condominium in one of Fairfield's County's most sought-after communities. This beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2 bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style and convenience just walking distant to restaurants, cafes, shopping parks, and the Metro-North Railroad for and easy NYC commute. Filled with both morning and afternoon sunlight, the home features custom floor-to- ceiling built-ins surrounding a marble electric fireplace, crown molding throughout, refreshed hardwood floors (2024) newer windows, and stylish new lighting. The refreshed kitchen (20024) includes a new refrigerator, microwave all stainless-steel appliances, while both full baths were beautifully renovated in 2024. Rare conveniences include a detached one-car garage and a deeded parking space just outside the rear entrance. Additional private basement storage. Enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds, two community pools and low-maintenance living with heat, A/C, hot water, snow and garbage removal, professionally managed included in the HOA. Located near top-rated public schools, new library and beloved town parks, this is the turnkey living in the heart of New Canaan. 125 Heritage Hill Road Unit A is a special place to call home.
